A plain-language guide to your electronics

Inside your devices

Choose a device to see the chips identified in its teardown, what their descriptions mean, and links to available datasheets.

About this report. These are source-linked identification entries, not a complete list of every chip physically inside each device. One entry may describe several chips, a stacked package, a sensor, or a module. Device variants may differ. Datasheet links describe the named part; they do not prove the part is present in the device. Plain-language roles are inferred from the wording of each identification. A missing document means no verified link is in this catalog, not that no datasheet exists. Custom parts may have no public datasheet.

Data: iFixit and its credited authors/contributors, under source-specific notices and CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. This report adds explanations, filtering, and a manufacturer datasheet catalog; source text and uncertainty are retained. Document links require internet access; browsing the report itself works offline.
